profile.headline: Sr. Principal Software Engineer at Cadence Design Systems
profile.summary: Every day I want to be challenged and to drive forward. I make sure I work on myself to be the best and am growing. I have always enjoyed working hard and getting something accomplished with a result that I can then apply. I enjoyed staying fit and competing in sports while in high school, college and even today. At a young age computer were something I knew I wanted to get into and I took the hard practice and competitive nature I had from sports to go and learn about them. I went to MSOE to continue that passion and learn more about software and hardware from their computer engineering program.

positions.title: Senior Development Engineer
positions.description: Developing C++ application. Creating and managing test environments. Managing computers. Testing developed software on new systems. Creating and managing UI Tests. Fixing Bugs that customers have found.

volunteerExperiences.role: Help with technology, streaming, and setting up events
volunteerExperiences.description: I help setup for events. I then stream the event so others that are unable to physically be there can view the event. I also look in to better ways to stream and always improve our quality of event for the people are aren't able to be there.
